'''Celestial Way''' was an avenue that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Xakrea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]], during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. The avenue branched out from the city's central plaza, and led to the [[Sanctum Celestial]], a fortress that served as the home of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]]. The [[Marble/Legends|marble]] statue ''[[Daiman's Rise]]'' faced in the direction of Celestial Way.
